trigger: a reader relies on 'its other text can change freely' when editing a vendored NOTICE
summary: The NOTICE sentence says its other text 'can change freely'. A NOTICE must now also be UTF-8 with no NUL byte and hold no run of more than 64 hex digits, or the check fails. Suggested text: '...other text can change freely, provided it stays UTF-8 with no NUL byte and holds no run of more than 64 hex digits'.
classification_rationale: The doc understates the rules the code enforces. The failure is loud and the SKILL row names both reasons, so the band stays LOW. Confirmed independently by consistency-auditor.

trigger: a later workflow edit adds continue-on-error or a masking if: to the augment or mark-image step
summary: sbom_edit_order_errors pins role count and order only. 16 mutants adding continue-on-error or if: to augment and mark-image in both server jobs were all accepted by it. The publish rig stubs both steps as no-ops, so nothing else catches them. The release job's pair check still refuses an unaugmented or unmarked server pair, so no wrong SBOM would ship. The failure would only move to after the tag move. Suggested fix: refuse any if or continue-on-error key on those steps.
classification_rationale: A test that does not pin an adjacent safety property. The release-job check is the backstop. chaos-injector (CH-NICE-1) reported the same item, with its own mutants.

trigger: a later refactor weakens the manifest-id regex from fullmatch to match/$, or drops the CycloneDX-half duplicate check
summary: The manifest-id test covers qr_codegen, a space, a slash and a non-ASCII id only. A trailing newline, an empty id and uppercase are untested. The pair-side duplicate check is tested only in the SPDX half. Today's code is correct: a chaos run refused a duplicate in both halves, and fullmatch rejects 'qr\n' and ''.
classification_rationale: Test-coverage gap on code that is correct today.

trigger: a NOTICE committed with many hash-shaped lines, run through check-vendored
summary: check-vendored prints every error with no cap, while vendored_components shows only the first 5 (line 1075). A garbage NOTICE gives unbounded stderr (300k lines in 0.7 s). Noise only, in a merge-gating check on author-controlled input. Not worth a fix.
classification_rationale: The two callers of the same error list disagree on how many errors to print. Cosmetic.

trigger: an operator follows the reset procedure on a runner that stays busy
summary: The 'once that runner is idle' instruction does not say how to check idleness, what to do if the runner never goes idle, or that a job can start between the check and the stop. The table already points to the other runners, and a cancelled job can be re-run. Mirrored in .codex/skills/release/SKILL.md.
classification_rationale: Runbook detail missing. Not a contradiction of code or policy.

trigger: a customer reads the release-verification SBOM section for a supply-chain questionnaire
summary: 'Each is a syft scan ... of the image by its digest' is not literally true of the two server images, whose pair is syft output plus the added vendored entries. Lines 745-752 correct it a few lines later. Separately, nothing in the SBOM section says the SBOM is not itself attested (its integrity is SHA256SUMS plus its cosign signature; the doc says so at line 403, and release.yml attests only build provenance). Optional one-line pointers for each.
classification_rationale: Nothing is false today. Each statement is corrected or covered elsewhere in the same doc, so this is a precision and cross-reference gap. docs-writer owns wording.
